name: Jian Hao Lim
bio:
Jian Hao Lim's path to motorsport started unconventionally, not on the track, but in the data labs. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the National University of Singapore, where he developed a passion for race car telemetry and simulation. After graduating, Jian joined a local racing team as a data analyst, quickly proving his worth by identifying performance gains that others had missed. His meticulous approach and ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies caught the attention of Dick Johnson Racing.

At DJR, Jian rose through the ranks, from junior engineer to head strategist, eventually earning the trust of the team owner and drivers. Now, as Team Principal, he blends his technical expertise with a collaborative management style. He emphasizes open communication, encourages his team to innovate, and holds himself and others to the highest standards. What sets Jian apart is his ability to foster a positive and supportive environment while maintaining a laser focus on achieving results. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his knack for making strategic decisions that often defy conventional wisdom.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Jian is of average height with a lean build, and often seen wearing sharp business attire.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his desk when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Singaporean coffee delivered to his office every morning.
